messages:
rachel: Quick design round 10m: the policy editor density toggle (compact/comfortable) is causing layout shift in the preview timeline. needs a decision so dev can ship the sim.

 tom: Saw that. On compact mode the rule cards collapse which is ok, but the timeline scrubber overlaps the rule badges on narrow screens.

 jules: Could we change the timeline to a floating overlay when width < 820px? That avoids reflow.

 ina: Floating overlay might hide important badges. Alternative: keep timeline inline but snap rules to fixed-height cards in compact so scrubber has reserved space.

 rachel: Preference for fixed-height cards in compact 10% fewer surprises for keyboard users. Floating overlays are fine but require focus trapping which complicates keyboard flow.

 tom: Agree. If we do fixed-height, we need to show an explicit "more" affordance in card to expand details. Also the drag ghost (when reordering) is invisible in compact because height clamps. Need to add an outline to the ghost.

 jules: Noted. For copy: the density toggle label currently says "Compact view" / "Comfortable view" 10sounds fine but maybe simpler: "Density: Compact" / "Density: Comfortable" with an info tooltip "affects card height and timeline layout".

 ina: Slight tweak: use nouns not verbs for toggle labels to match other console toggles. "Density: Compact" reads better.

 rachel: Cool. Another copy tweak: when a rule fails validation we show a toast that disappears in 4s. Designers think that's too short. Suggest persistent inline validation on the rule plus an optional dismissible toast. Copy for inline: "Priority conflict: two rules share priority 5. Make them unique or reorder." Keep toast message shorter: "Priority conflict in rule 3" with link "Fix".

 tom: Love that. Implementation detail: inline message should include a small icon and link to auto-solve ("Auto-resolve by nudging down"). We should avoid modal.

 jules: Accessibility: when the simulation plays, screen readers need updates. We should announce progress updates via aria-live="polite": "Simulation: 3 of 12 events matched" and a final summary in aria-live="assertive": "Simulation complete: 4 rules matched". Thoughts?

 ina: Good. But assertive may interrupt. Maybe keep all as polite and provide an optional "Announce result" button for assertive readout.

 rachel: Ok keep polite by default and add a small "Announce results" button. Add tooltip: "Plays full simulation and reads summary aloud".

 preview-bot: Simulation run queued: label=\"timeline-density-check\", 20 runs across widths [360, 768, 1024], prioritizing compact mode.

 tom: One more tiny UX: scrubber hover tooltip currently shows absolute time like "00:00:12" but rules are event-indexed. Change text to "Event 6 of 20" and show absolute time in details panel. Less cognitive load.

 jules: Agree. Also add visual match highlights on rule cards during timeline playback: subtle glow + small badge "matched". Keep animation subtle (fade-in 120ms).

 rachel: For reorder ghost, propose 2px dashed high-contrast border + 8px vertical offset so it doesn't overlap fixed-height neighbors.

 ina: PR checklist for dev: 1) implement density labels + tooltip, 2) clamp card height in compact and reserve timeline space, 3) update drag ghost styling, 4) inline validation + toast, 5) aria-live updates + announce button, 6) scrubber tooltip copy.

 tom: I'll pick this up. Will include unit tests for timeline overlap at widths 360/768 and keyboard nav when scrubber is focused.

 preview-bot: Simulation run complete 10 20 runs, 2 failures on width 360 due to scrubber z-index. Fail logs: "scrubberOverlap=true at run 7, 15".

 rachel: Great catch. tom, can you handle z-index fix and ensure focus order unchanged?

 tom: Yep will add z-index and ensure focusable scrubber has aria-describedby referencing event count.

 jules: Copy for inline validation (final): "Priority conflict: Two rules share the same priority. Use drag or change the priority to fix." Toast: "Priority conflict in Rule 3" and action text "Fix".

 rachel: Awesome. If the follow-up sim passes, we'll roll this into the next patch. ETA for PR?

 tom: EOD tomorrow, ping me if blocked.

 rachel: Thanks team! :rocket:
